subject: Invoice delivery preference, VAT evidence needs, and PO mapping
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@veridatainc.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@veridatainc.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T07:15:00Z
Subject: Invoice delivery — preferred channel + VAT evidence

Hi Tessa,

Quick question from our AP side as we start provisioning new vendors for EU entities: how would Redwood prefer we receive invoices? Our options here are: (A) the vendor portal (preferred by our AP system), (B) monthly PDF emailed to billing@veridatainc.com, or (C) e-invoice XML push to our collector.

Also we need a VAT certificate or EU tax registration evidence on file for invoicing — can you point me to where we can get that? Finally, please confirm the invoice sender and whether we'll need a PO number to map invoices to our system (we usually prefer PO on invoice).

Thanks,

Ellen Park
Head of Accounts Payable
Verida Inc.

[attachment: company_tax_vat_request_template.xlsx]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@veridatainc.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery — preferred channel + VAT evidence

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to align on whatever makes Verida easiest. High-level proposal:

- Primary: Redwood Portal push (we can activate your AP account and push invoices into your collector/feed). Portal provides line-level data, attachments, and an audit trail.
- Email fallback: PDF copies to billing@veridatainc.com (same day invoices are posted) for teams that still rely on emailed PDFs.
- Optional: XML push if you need it — Connor has the schema and can note collector endpoints (SFTP / webhook).

On VAT evidence: we host our EU VAT certificate and legal entity docs in a secure snapshot for customers requiring tax proof. I attached a short onboarding spec and a sample XML so your ops team can see the shape. If you need the official VAT certificate, reply and Kimberly will provide the signed PDF.

Immediate asks / mutual action items:
- Ellen: confirm whether you want portal as primary (we'll enable account + user invite) or if you want XML push to a collector endpoint.
- Verida AP: confirm preferred invoice filename/PO mapping format (e.g., PO: PO-12345 or numeric only).
- Kimberly / Connor: we will prepare activation steps and the SFTP/Webhook requirements.

Thanks — I can do a 30m sync if helpful.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0147

[attachment: verida_einvoice_spec.xlsx]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@veridatainc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery — preferred channel + VAT evidence

Thanks Tessa / Ellen — quick technical notes (so Verida's engineers / AP can review):

- If Verida chooses XML push: we support two delivery modes: (1) SFTP drop (weekly/daily) or (2) API webhook (near real-time). Payloads follow the attached sample_invoice.xml and a companion XSD in the spec.
- Filename / PO mapping: we recommend invoice metadata include a header block with invoice_number, invoice_date, customer_po (optional), and billing_entity_id. If you prefer PO-only mapping, we can set a rule to route on exact PO match and send a rejection report for unmatched invoices.
- Portal: when portal is enabled we still generate the XML for archival; we can also enable daily aggregated PDF bundles for your AP mailbox.

Ellen — attaching a sample_invoice.xml (sanitized). If you decide on SFTP, please share host, user, preferred auth (key or password), and retention SLA. If webhook, share the endpoint and HMAC secret rotation policy.

Cheers,

Connor O'Brien
Billing & Integrations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: sample_invoice.xml]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@veridatainc.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:42:00Z
Subject: Finalizing delivery channel and PO mapping for Verida (next steps)

Hi Ellen — following up to lock the plan in. Per Tessa and Connor's notes, Redwood will: 

1) Primary delivery: enable Verida AP account in the Redwood Portal (we will push invoices to your collector feed). We will send user invites to the billing@veridatainc.com mailbox once activation is complete.
2) Email copies: we will deliver daily PDF bundles to billing@veridatainc.com as a fallback; single-invoice PDFs will be available on request.
3) XML: available on request. If you want XML via SFTP, please provide the connection details and whether you prefer key-based auth.
4) Invoice sender: invoices will originate from invoices@redwood.ai and include billing_entity_id: REDWOOD-EU-01 on the header. Please map that value in your AP system so invoices route correctly.
5) PO mapping: please confirm whether you will include customer PO in the invoice header as "customer_po" (recommended). If you need PO-only matching we will turn on strict PO routing and generate an exceptions report for unrecognized PO numbers.

Attached is our MAP (Master AP Preferences) for signature — once we have the signed MAP and your SFTP/webhook details (if applicable) we will activate portal push and share a test invoice. Also attached: the signed VAT certificate PDF.

Action items for Verida AP:
- Reply with: (A) portal primary sign-on email (which user should receive invites), (B) confirm PO format (example), and (C) SFTP/webhook details if you want XML.

We aim to have a test invoice posted within 48 hours of receiving the MAP and any connection details.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0122
